t: "阿纳格尼条约"是教宗为结束西西里卫斯珀斯人之战而调解的一次尝试,由阿拉贡王冠,法兰西王国和那…
te: The Treaty of Anagni, an attempt mediated by the papacy to end the War of the Sicilian Vespers, is signed by the crown …
dz: "阿纳格尼条约"是教宗为结束西西里卫斯珀斯人之战而调解的一次尝试,由阿拉贡王冠,法兰西王国和那不勒斯王国所签署.
de: The Treaty of Anagni, an attempt mediated by the papacy to end the War of the Sicilian Vespers, is signed by the crown of Aragon, the kingdom of France and kingdom of Naples.

t: 普雷泽米什瓦二世继杜卡尔时期后加冕为波兰国王. 白鹰被添加到波兰的臂章上.
te: Przemysł II crowned king of Poland, following Ducal period. The white eagle is added to the Polish coat of arms.
dz: 普雷泽米什瓦二世继杜卡尔时期后加冕为波兰国王. 白鹰被添加到波兰的臂章上.
de: Przemysł II crowned king of Poland, following Ducal period. The white eagle is added to the Polish coat of arms.

t: 苏格兰与法国为对抗英格兰而缔结“老同盟”的第一份条约在巴黎签署。
te: The first treaty forming the Auld Alliance between Scotland and France against England is signed in Paris.
dz: 苏格兰与法国为对抗英格兰而缔结“老同盟”的第一份条约在巴黎签署。
de: The first treaty forming the Auld Alliance between Scotland and France against England is signed in Paris.
